title: Mercado Livre Coupon: Early Discounts and 9.9 Deals
seoTitle: Mercado Livre Coupon: Early Discounts & 9.9 Deals
subtitle: Learn how to take advantage of up to 10% coupons and up to 70% discounts on electronics before the official date
excerpt: Mercado Livre launched coupons for up to 10% off, limited to R$30, and an early round of the 9.9 campaign with electronics up to 70% OFF.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Last Tuesday, Mercado Livre announced two types of benefits that put the site in the spotlight: 10% discount coupons, limited to R$30, and a pre-sale for the 9.9 campaign with electronics up to 70% off. The combination of coupons and early discounts boosted consumer demand.

How Mercado Livre Coupons Work

There are two codes valid sitewide, each guaranteeing a 10% discount – up to R$30 – on purchases of R$79 or more. To use, simply copy the code, visit the website, and apply it in your cart. The coupons have activation limits and may run out quickly.

What the Early 9.9 Campaign Offers

The "9.9 A Tech Turnaround" campaign offers electronics from brands like Samsung, Apple, Motorola, Acer, and Lenovo with discounts up to 70%. Products on promotion include smartphones, notebooks, tablets, and accessories such as smartwatches and headphones.

  • Apple iPhone 17 256 GB Smartphone for R$ 5,309.10
  • Samsung Galaxy S26 5G 256 GB Smartphone for R$ 4,319.10
  • Samsung Galaxy Book4 Intel Core i5-1335U Notebook for R$ 3,901.39
  • Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Lite 128 GB Tablet for R$ 2,327.35
  • Samsung Galaxy Watch8 40 mm Smartwatch for R$ 1,349.10

How to Combine Coupons and 9.9 Deals

The coupons are valid sitewide, including for products in the 9.9 campaign. Thus, when choosing an item with, for example, a 70% discount, it is still possible to apply the 10% coupon (limited to R$30) to further reduce the final price.

Extra Benefits for Meli+ Subscribers

Meli+ program subscribers receive exclusive coupons, access to streaming services, and differentiated installment payment conditions. Furthermore, the balance yield in Mercado Pago can reach up to 120% of the CDI.

Tips to Secure the Best Price

Check the codes as soon as possible, as the number of activations is limited. Use the coupon before finalizing your purchase and verify if the chosen product already has the 9.9 campaign discount applied. This way, the final price can be well below the list price.

With information from TecMundo, Melhores Cartões.
